    // Uniqueness Probability
    double uniqueness_prob() {
        std::vector<double> sim_scores = {0.05, 0.1, 0.15, 0.2, 0.25};
        double mean = 0.0;
        for (double score : sim_scores) mean += score;
        mean /= sim_scores.size();
        double std_dev = 0.0;
        for (double score : sim_scores) std_dev += (score - mean) * (score - mean);
        std_dev = std::sqrt(std_dev / sim_scores.size());
        double z = (mean - 0.1) / (0.05 * std::sqrt(2.0));
        double cdf = 0.5 * (1.0 + std::erf(z));
        return 1.0 - cdf;  // ~0.1587 general
    }

    // Equation Functions (all from thread, including new MUGE for NGC 2525)
    double F_U(double g_compressed, double sum_Ugi, double sum_mu_j, double g_mu_nu, double F_neutron, double Ui, double F_p, double a_THz, double f_TRZ_log, double PDE, double f_res_term, double sigma_term, double h_TT_ij, double Gamma_term, double Delta_q_term, double W_tau_m_term, double F_nonlocal, double MUGE_term) {
        return g_compressed + sum_Ugi + sum_mu_j + g_mu_nu + F_neutron + Ui + F_p + a_THz + f_TRZ_log + PDE + f_res_term + sigma_term + h_TT_ij + Gamma_term + Delta_q_term + W_tau_m_term + F_nonlocal + MUGE_term;
    }

    double E_react(double rho_SCm, double v_SCm, double rho_A, double kappa_decay, double t) {
        return (rho_SCm * v_SCm * v_SCm / rho_A) * std::exp(-kappa_decay * t);
    }

    double Ui(double lambda_i, double rho_vac_SCm, double rho_vac_UA, double omega_s, double t_n, double f_TRZ) {
        return lambda_i * rho_vac_SCm * rho_vac_UA * omega_s * std::cos(M_PI * t_n) * (1 + f_TRZ);
    }

    double f_res(double h_bar, double Z, double m_H, double r_n, double n, double alpha_FS) {
        return (2 * M_PI * h_bar * Z / (m_H * r_n)) * std::sqrt(n / alpha_FS);
    }

    double g_compressed(const SystemParams& params) {
        double g_base = G * params.M / (params.r * params.r);
        double H_z = H0 * std::sqrt(0.3 * std::pow(1 + params.z, 3) + 0.7);
        double term1 = 1 + H_z * params.t;
        double term2 = 1 - params.B / B_crit;
        double term3 = Lambda * c * c / 3;
        double term4 = hbar / std::sqrt(delta_x_delta_p) * psi_H_psi * (2 * M_PI / t_Hubble);
        double term5 = params.rho_fluid * params.V * g_base;
        double term6 = (params.M / 2 + params.M / 2) * (delta_rho_rho + 3 * G * params.M / (params.r * params.r * params.r));
        return g_base * term1 * term2 + term6 + term3 + term4 + term5;  // Simplified
    }

    double F_nonlocal(double v_p, double v_g, double t, double F_rel) {
        return (v_p / v_g) * std::exp(-(M_PI - t)) * F_rel;
    }

    double Delta_q(double p_Q) {
        return p_Q * p_Q + p_Q;
    }

    double Gamma_LENR(double beta, double beta_o) {
        return 1.2e13 * (beta - beta_o) * (beta - beta_o);
    }

    double h_TT_ij(double r, double d2_I_kl, double P_ik, double P_jl) {
        return (2 / r) * d2_I_kl * P_ik * P_jl;
    }

    double Q_lambda_f(double c_lambda, double integral_e_H_Ff) {
        return 1.0 / (c_lambda * c_lambda) * integral_e_H_Ff;
    }

    double f_Q_log(double Q, double alpha, double beta, double Q0) {
        return Q + alpha * std::log(1 + beta * Q / Q0);
    }

    double f_Q_inverse_log(double Q, double alpha, double beta, double Q0) {
        return Q + alpha / std::log(1 + beta * Q / Q0);
    }

    double neutrino_transport(double df_nu_dt, double v_grad_f_nu, double C_f_nu) {
        return df_nu_dt + v_grad_f_nu - C_f_nu;
    }

    double log_M_BH(double sigma) {
        return 0.309 * std::log(sigma / 200) + 4.38;
    }

    bool He_core_threshold(double M_He) {
        return M_He > 5.6;
    }

    double viscous_hydro(double partial_t_u_mu, double u_nu_grad_nu_u_mu, double epsilon_P, double grad_mu_P, double u_mu_u_nu_grad_nu_P, double nu_grad_nu_tau_mu_nu) {
        return partial_t_u_mu + u_nu_grad_nu_u_mu + 1.0 / epsilon_P * (grad_mu_P + u_mu_u_nu_grad_nu_P) + nu_grad_nu_tau_mu_nu;
    }

    double PBH_baryogenesis(double phi, double M, double K, double eta, double partial_mu_phi, double J_mu_B) {
        return (phi / M) * K + eta * partial_mu_phi * J_mu_B;
    }

    double delta_sigma_dark(double nu, double G, double partial_mu_phi, double partial_mu_phi_conj) {
        return (nu / G) * partial_mu_phi * partial_mu_phi_conj;
    }

    double dot_r_IMRI(double G, double M, double m, double mu, double c, double r, double v) {
        return - (64 * std::pow(G, 3) * std::pow(M, 2) * m * mu) / (5 * std::pow(c, 5) * std::pow(r, 3)) * (1 + (3 * G * M * v) / (2 * std::pow(c, 2) * r));
    }

    double S_f_spectral(double f, double alpha) {
        return std::pow(f, -alpha);
    }

    double g_M16(double G, double M_t, double r, double H_z, double t, double B, double B_crit, double M_sf_t, double Ug_sum, double Lambda, double c, double h_bar, double sqrt_delta_x_p, double integral_psi, double two_pi_t_Hubble, double q, double v_B, double rho_fluid, double V, double g, double A, double k, double x, double omega, double two_pi_13_8, std::complex<double> i_k_x_omega_t, double M_visible, double M_DM, double delta_rho_rho, double three_G_M_r3, double E_rad) {
        double g_base = G * M_t / (r * r);
        double term1 = 1 + H_z * t;
        double term2 = 1 - B / B_crit;
        double term3 = 1 + M_sf_t;
        double term4 = Lambda * c * c / 3;
        double term5 = h_bar / sqrt_delta_x_p * integral_psi * two_pi_t_Hubble;
        double term6 = q * v_B;
        double term7 = rho_fluid * V * g;
        double term8 = 2 * A * std::cos(k * x) * std::cos(omega * t);
        double term9 = two_pi_13_8 * A * std::exp(i_k_x_omega_t);
        double term10 = (M_visible + M_DM) * (delta_rho_rho + three_G_M_r3);
        return g_base * term1 * term2 * term3 + Ug_sum + term4 + term5 + term6 + term7 + term8 + term9 + term10 - E_rad;
    }

    double g_NGC1275(double G, double M, double r, double H_z, double t, double B, double B_crit, double F_BH, double Ug_sum, double Lambda, double c, double h_bar, double sqrt_delta_x_p, double integral_psi, double two_pi_t_Hubble, double q, double v_B, double rho_fluid, double V, double g, double A, double k, double x, double omega, double two_pi_13_8, std::complex<double> i_k_x_omega_t, double M_visible, double M_DM, double delta_rho_rho, double three_G_M_r3, double M_fil) {
        double g_base = G * M / (r * r);
        double term1 = 1 + H_z * t;
        double term2 = 1 - B / B_crit;
        double term3 = Lambda * c * c / 3;
        double term4 = h_bar / sqrt(delta_x_delta_p) * integral_psi * two_pi_t_Hubble;
        double term5 = q * v_B;
        double term6 = rho_fluid * V * g;
        double term7 = 2 * A * std::cos(k * x) * std::cos(omega * t);
        double term8 = two_pi_13_8 * A * std::exp(i_k_x_omega_t);
        double term9 = (M_visible + M_DM) * (delta_rho_rho + three_G_M_r3);
        return g_base * term1 * term2 + F_BH + Ug_sum + term3 + term4 + term5 + term6 + term7 + term8 + term9 + M_fil;
    }

    // New: delta_def function
    double delta_def(double t) {
        return 0.01 * std::sin(0.001 * t);
    }

    // New: U_g1 with delta_def
    double U_g1(double k1, double mu_s, double grad_M_s_r, double alpha, double t, double t_n, double delta_def_val) {
        return k1 * mu_s * grad_M_s_r * std::exp(-alpha * t) * std::cos(M_PI * t_n) * (1 + delta_def_val);
    }

    // New: Pondermotive force F_p (from Ideal Gravity integration)
    double pondermotive_F_p(double e, double m, double omega, double grad_E2) {
        return - (e * e / (4 * m * omega * omega)) * grad_E2;
    }

    // New: A_mu_nu (simplified scalar for example)
    double A_mu_nu(double g_mu_nu, double eta, double T_s_mu_nu) {
        return g_mu_nu + eta * T_s_mu_nu;
    }

    // New: U_bi with epsilon_sw
    double U_bi(double beta_i, double U_gi, double Omega_g, double M_bh, double d_g, double epsilon_sw, double rho_vac_sw, double U_UA, double t_n) {
        return - beta_i * U_gi * Omega_g * (M_bh / d_g) * (1 + epsilon_sw * rho_vac_sw) * U_UA * std::cos(M_PI * t_n);
    }

    // New: U_g4 with f_feedback
    double U_g4(double k4, double rho_vac_SCm, double M_bh, double d_g, double alpha, double t, double t_n, double f_feedback) {
        return k4 * (rho_vac_SCm * M_bh / d_g) * std::exp(-alpha * t) * std::cos(M_PI * t_n) * (1 + f_feedback);
    }

    // New: U_m with f_Heaviside
    double U_m(double mu_j, double r_j, double gamma_decay, double t, double t_n, double phi_hat_j, double P_SCm, double E_react, double f_quasi, double f_Heaviside) {
        return (mu_j / r_j) * (1 - std::exp(-gamma_decay * t * std::cos(M_PI * t_n))) * phi_hat_j * P_SCm * E_react * (1 + std::pow(10, 13) * f_Heaviside) * (1 + f_quasi);
    }

    // New: U_g2 with H_SCm
    double U_g2(double k2, double rho_vac_UA, double rho_vac_SCm, double M_s, double r, double S_r_Rb, double delta_sw, double v_sw, double H_SCm, double E_react) {
        return k2 * ((rho_vac_UA + rho_vac_SCm) * M_s / (r * r)) * S_r_Rb * (1 + delta_sw * v_sw) * H_SCm * E_react;
    }

    // New: U_g3 with P_core
    double U_g3(double k3, double B_j, double omega_s, double t, double P_core, double E_react) {
        return k3 * B_j * std::cos(omega_s * t * M_PI) * P_core * E_react;
    }

    }

        return 1000 + 0.4 * std::sin(omega_c * t);

Unified Field Equation The total energy density F_U (in J/m^3) is given by: F_U = ∑i [k_i ⋅ U{gi}(r, t, M_s, ω_s, T_s, B_s, ρ_{vac,[SCm]}, ρ_{vac,[UA]}, t_n) - β_i ⋅ U_{gi} ⋅ Ω_g ⋅ M_{bh}/d_g ⋅ E_react ] + ∑j [μ_j/r_j ⋅ (1 - e^{-γ t ⋅ cos(π t_n)} ) ⋅ \hat{ϕ}j ] + (g{μν} + η ⋅ T_s^{μν}) - ∑_i [λ_i ⋅ U_i ⋅ E_react ] Components of the Framework Equations Universal Gravity Terms (U{gi}) U_{g1} (Internal Dipole): U_{g1} = k_1 ⋅ μ_s (t, ρ_{vac,[SCm]}) ⋅ ∇(M_s / r) e^{-α t} ⋅ cos(π t_n) ⋅ (1 + δ_{def}) U_{g2} (Outer Field Bubble): U_{g2} = k_2 ⋅ ((ρ_{vac,[UA]} + ρ_{vac,[SCm]} ) M_s)/r^2 ⋅ S(r - R_b) ⋅ (1 + δ_{sw} ⋅ v_{sw}) ⋅ H_{SCm} ⋅ E_react U_{g3} (Magnetic Strings Disk): U_{g3} = k_3 ⋅ ∑j B_j(r, θ, t, ρ{vac,[SCm]}) ⋅ cos(ω_s (t) t ⋅ π) ⋅ P_{core} ⋅ E_react U_{g4} (Star-Black Hole Interactions): U_{g4} = k_4 ⋅ ρ_{vac,[SCm]} M_{bh}/d_g ⋅ e^{-α t} ⋅ cos(π t_n) ⋅ (1 + f_{feedback}) Universal Magnetism (U_m): U_m = ∑j [μ_j (t, ρ{vac,[SCm]})/r_j ⋅ (1 - e^{-γ t ⋅ cos(π t_n)} ) ⋅ \hat{ϕ}j ] ⋅ P{SCm} ⋅ E_react ⋅ (1 + 10^{13} ⋅ f_{Heaviside}) ⋅ (1 + f_{quasi}) Universal Inertia (U_i): U_i = λ_i ⋅ ρ_{vac,[SCm]} ⋅ ρ_{vac,[UA]} ⋅ ω_s (t) ⋅ cos(π t_n) ⋅ (1 + f_{TRZ}) Incorporation of Pondermotive Force: Ideal Gravity introduces the force, which can be integrated into U_i to model the influence of oscillating electromagnetic fields in TRZs: F_p = - e^2 / (4 m ω^2) ∇(E^2) This force may contribute to the negentropic effects in TRZs, enhancing inertial resistance by driving charged particles (e.g., [SCm] components) toward regions of weaker field strength, potentially increasing the effective energy density. Universal Cosmic Aether (A_{μν} or [UA]): A_{μν} = g_{μν} + η ⋅ T_s^{μν} (ρ_{vac,[UA]}, ρ_{vac,[SCm]}, ρ_{vac,A}, t_n) Aether as a Superfluid: Ideal Gravity describes the Aether as a superfluid medium, with quantized vortices forming elementary particles. This aligns with your framework’s view of [UA] as a fundamental medium, where TRZs may arise from specific vortex configurations that enable time-reversal effects. Parameters and Variables • f_{TRZ}: Time-reversal zone factor, 0.1, scales the inertial energy density by 10%, reflecting the influence of TRZs on negentropic and time-reversal dynamics. • ρ_{vac,[SCm]}: Vacuum energy density of [SCm], 7.09×10^{-37} J/m^3 (Sun, level 13). • ρ_{vac,[UA]}: Vacuum energy density of [UA], 7.09×10^{-36} J/m^3 (Sun, level 13). • ρ_{vac,A}: Vacuum energy density of the Aether, 10^{-23} J/m^3, a constant background energy density. • t_n: Negative time factor, t_n = t - t^0, which introduces time-reversal effects with a 2-day period (cos(π t_n)). • E_react: Reactor efficiency factor, incorporating time-reversal effects: E_react = 10^{46} ⋅ e^{-0.0005 t} Phenomena and Applications • Nebular Dynamics (Drawing 32): TRZs enhance inertial resistance, stabilizing dust and gas motion. • Star Formation (Drawing 33): TRZs increase resistance to gravitational collapse, influencing dynamics and jet formation. • Galactic Disk Stability (Drawing 33): TRZs contribute to stability by resisting dynamic changes. • Vacuum Energy Extraction (Drawing 30): TRZs enable negentropic processes, such as energy extraction with COP > 1.0, as supported by Ideal Gravity’s discussion of ZPE and the Aether.     // Uniqueness Probability
    double uniqueness_prob() {
        std::vector<double> sim_scores = {0.05, 0.1, 0.15, 0.2, 0.25};
        double mean = 0.0;
        for (double score : sim_scores) mean += score;
        mean /= sim_scores.size();
        double std_dev = 0.0;
        for (double score : sim_scores) std_dev += (score - mean) * (score - mean);
        std_dev = std::sqrt(std_dev / sim_scores.size());
        double z = (mean - 0.1) / (0.05 * std::sqrt(2.0));
        double cdf = 0.5 * (1.0 + std::erf(z));
        return 1.0 - cdf;  // ~0.1587 general
    }

    // Equation Functions (all from thread, including new MUGE for NGC 2525)
    double F_U(double g_compressed, double sum_Ugi, double sum_mu_j, double g_mu_nu, double F_neutron, double Ui, double F_p, double a_THz, double f_TRZ_log, double PDE, double f_res_term, double sigma_term, double h_TT_ij, double Gamma_term, double Delta_q_term, double W_tau_m_term, double F_nonlocal, double MUGE_term) {
        return g_compressed + sum_Ugi + sum_mu_j + g_mu_nu + F_neutron + Ui + F_p + a_THz + f_TRZ_log + PDE + f_res_term + sigma_term + h_TT_ij + Gamma_term + Delta_q_term + W_tau_m_term + F_nonlocal + MUGE_term;
    }

    double E_react(double rho_SCm, double v_SCm, double rho_A, double kappa_decay, double t) {
        return (rho_SCm * v_SCm * v_SCm / rho_A) * std::exp(-kappa_decay * t);
    }

    double Ui(double lambda_i, double rho_vac_SCm, double rho_vac_UA, double omega_s, double t_n, double f_TRZ) {
        return lambda_i * rho_vac_SCm * rho_vac_UA * omega_s * std::cos(M_PI * t_n) * (1 + f_TRZ);
    }

    double f_res(double h_bar, double Z, double m_H, double r_n, double n, double alpha_FS) {
        return (2 * M_PI * h_bar * Z / (m_H * r_n)) * std::sqrt(n / alpha_FS);
    }

    double g_compressed(const SystemParams& params) {
        double g_base = G * params.M / (params.r * params.r);
        double H_z = H0 * std::sqrt(0.3 * std::pow(1 + params.z, 3) + 0.7);
        double term1 = 1 + H_z * params.t;
        double term2 = 1 - params.B / B_crit;
        double term3 = Lambda * c * c / 3;
        double term4 = hbar / std::sqrt(delta_x_delta_p) * psi_H_psi * (2 * M_PI / t_Hubble);
        double term5 = params.rho_fluid * params.V * g_base;
        double term6 = (params.M / 2 + params.M / 2) * (delta_rho_rho + 3 * G * params.M / (params.r * params.r * params.r));
        return g_base * term1 * term2 + term6 + term3 + term4 + term5;  // Simplified
    }

    double F_nonlocal(double v_p, double v_g, double t, double F_rel) {
        return (v_p / v_g) * std::exp(-(M_PI - t)) * F_rel;
    }

    double Delta_q(double p_Q) {
        return p_Q * p_Q + p_Q;
    }

    double Gamma_LENR(double beta, double beta_o) {
        return 1.2e13 * (beta - beta_o) * (beta - beta_o);
    }

    double h_TT_ij(double r, double d2_I_kl, double P_ik, double P_jl) {
        return (2 / r) * d2_I_kl * P_ik * P_jl;
    }

    double Q_lambda_f(double c_lambda, double integral_e_H_Ff) {
        return 1.0 / (c_lambda * c_lambda) * integral_e_H_Ff;
    }

    double f_Q_log(double Q, double alpha, double beta, double Q0) {
        return Q + alpha * std::log(1 + beta * Q / Q0);
    }

    double f_Q_inverse_log(double Q, double alpha, double beta, double Q0) {
        return Q + alpha / std::log(1 + beta * Q / Q0);
    }

    double neutrino_transport(double df_nu_dt, double v_grad_f_nu, double C_f_nu) {
        return df_nu_dt + v_grad_f_nu - C_f_nu;
    }

        return - (64 * std::pow(G, 3) * std::pow(M, 2) * m * mu) / (5 * std::pow(c, 5) * std::pow(r, 3)) * (1 + (3 * G * M * v) / (2 * std::pow(c, 2) * r));
    }

    double g_M16(double G, double M_t, double r, double H_z, double t, double B, double B_crit, double M_sf_t, double Ug_sum, double Lambda, double c, double h_bar, double sqrt_delta_x_p, double integral_psi, double two_pi_t_Hubble, double q, double v_B, double rho_fluid, double V, double g, double A, double k, double x, double omega, double two_pi_13_8, std::complex<double> i_k_x_omega_t, double M_visible, double M_DM, double delta_rho_rho, double three_G_M_r3, double E_rad) {
        double g_base = G * M_t / (r * r);
        double term1 = 1 + H_z * t;
        double term2 = 1 - B / B_crit;
        double term3 = 1 + M_sf_t;
        double term4 = Lambda * c * c / 3;
        double term5 = h_bar / sqrt_delta_x_p * integral_psi * two_pi_t_Hubble;
        double term6 = q * v_B;
        double term7 = rho_fluid * V * g;
        double term8 = 2 * A * std::cos(k * x) * std::cos(omega * t);
        double term9 = two_pi_13_8 * A * std::exp(i_k_x_omega_t);
        double term10 = (M_visible + M_DM) * (delta_rho_rho + three_G_M_r3);
        return g_base * term1 * term2 * term3 + Ug_sum + term4 + term5 + term6 + term7 + term8 + term9 + term10 - E_rad;
    }

    double g_NGC1275(double G, double M, double r, double H_z, double t, double B, double B_crit, double F_BH, double Ug_sum, double Lambda, double c, double h_bar, double sqrt_delta_x_p, double integral_psi, double two_pi_t_Hubble, double q, double v_B, double rho_fluid, double V, double g, double A, double k, double x, double omega, double two_pi_13_8, std::complex<double> i_k_x_omega_t, double M_visible, double M_DM, double delta_rho_rho, double three_G_M_r3, double M_fil) {
        double g_base = G * M / (r * r);
        double term1 = 1 + H_z * t;
        double term2 = 1 - B / B_crit;

        double term4 = h_bar / sqrt(delta_x_delta_p) * integral_psi * two_pi_t_Hubble;
        double term5 = q * v_B;

        double term9 = (M_visible + M_DM) * (delta_rho_rho + three_G_M_r3);
        return g_base * term1 * term2 + F_BH + Ug_sum + term3 + term4 + term5 + term6 + term7 + term8 + term9 + M_fil;
    }

    const double B_s_min = 1e-4;  // Surface magnetic field min T for Sun
    const double B_s_max = 0.4;  // Surface magnetic field max T for Sun

    // Uniqueness Probability
    double uniqueness_prob() {
        std::vector<double> sim_scores = {0.05, 0.1, 0.15, 0.2, 0.25};
        double mean = 0.0;
        for (double score : sim_scores) mean += score;
        mean /= sim_scores.size();
        double std_dev = 0.0;
        for (double score : sim_scores) std_dev += (score - mean) * (score - mean);
        std_dev = std::sqrt(std_dev / sim_scores.size());
        double z = (mean - 0.1) / (0.05 * std::sqrt(2.0));
        double cdf = 0.5 * (1.0 + std::erf(z));
        return 1.0 - cdf;  // ~0.1587 general
    }

    // Equation Functions (all from thread, including new MUGE for NGC 2525)
    double F_U(double g_compressed, double sum_Ugi, double sum_mu_j, double g_mu_nu, double F_neutron, double Ui, double F_p, double a_THz, double f_TRZ_log, double PDE, double f_res_term, double sigma_term, double h_TT_ij, double Gamma_term, double Delta_q_term, double W_tau_m_term, double F_nonlocal, double MUGE_term) {
        return g_compressed + sum_Ugi + sum_mu_j + g_mu_nu + F_neutron + Ui + F_p + a_THz + f_TRZ_log + PDE + f_res_term + sigma_term + h_TT_ij + Gamma_term + Delta_q_term + W_tau_m_term + F_nonlocal + MUGE_term;
    }

    double E_react(double rho_SCm, double v_SCm, double rho_A, double kappa_decay, double t) {
        return (rho_SCm * v_SCm * v_SCm / rho_A) * std::exp(-kappa_decay * t);
    }

    double Ui(double lambda_i, double rho_vac_SCm, double rho_vac_UA, double omega_s, double t_n, double f_TRZ) {
        return lambda_i * rho_vac_SCm * rho_vac_UA * omega_s * std::cos(M_PI * t_n) * (1 + f_TRZ);
    }

    double f_res(double h_bar, double Z, double m_H, double r_n, double n, double alpha_FS) {
        return (2 * M_PI * h_bar * Z / (m_H * r_n)) * std::sqrt(n / alpha_FS);
    }

    double g_compressed(const SystemParams& params) {
        double g_base = G * params.M / (params.r * params.r);
        double H_z = H0 * std::sqrt(0.3 * std::pow(1 + params.z, 3) + 0.7);
        double term1 = 1 + H_z * params.t;
        double term2 = 1 - params.B / B_crit;
        double term3 = Lambda * c * c / 3;
        double term4 = hbar / std::sqrt(delta_x_delta_p) * psi_H_psi * (2 * M_PI / t_Hubble);
        double term5 = params.rho_fluid * params.V * g_base;
        double term6 = (params.M / 2 + params.M / 2) * (delta_rho_rho + 3 * G * params.M / (params.r * params.r * params.r));
        return g_base * term1 * term2 + term6 + term3 + term4 + term5;  // Simplified
    }

    double F_nonlocal(double v_p, double v_g, double t, double F_rel) {
        return (v_p / v_g) * std::exp(-(M_PI - t)) * F_rel;
    }

    double Delta_q(double p_Q) {
        return p_Q * p_Q + p_Q;
    }

    double Gamma_LENR(double beta, double beta_o) {
        return 1.2e13 * (beta - beta_o) * (beta - beta_o);
    }

    double h_TT_ij(double r, double d2_I_kl, double P_ik, double P_jl) {
        return (2 / r) * d2_I_kl * P_ik * P_jl;
    }

    double Q_lambda_f(double c_lambda, double integral_e_H_Ff) {
        return 1.0 / (c_lambda * c_lambda) * integral_e_H_Ff;
    }

    double f_Q_log(double Q, double alpha, double beta, double Q0) {
        return Q + alpha * std::log(1 + beta * Q / Q0);
    }

    double f_Q_inverse_log(double Q, double alpha, double beta, double Q0) {
        return Q + alpha / std::log(1 + beta * Q / Q0);
    }

    double neutrino_transport(double df_nu_dt, double v_grad_f_nu, double C_f_nu) {
        return df_nu_dt + v_grad_f_nu - C_f_nu;
    }

    double log_M_BH(double sigma) {
        return 0.309 * std::log(sigma / 200) + 4.38;
    }

    bool He_core_threshold(double M_He) {
        return M_He > 5.6;
    }

    double viscous_hydro(double partial_t_u_mu, double u_nu_grad_nu_u_mu, double epsilon_P, double grad_mu_P, double u_mu_u_nu_grad_nu_P, double nu_grad_nu_tau_mu_nu) {
        return partial_t_u_mu + u_nu_grad_nu_u_mu + 1.0 / epsilon_P * (grad_mu_P + u_mu_u_nu_grad_nu_P) + nu_grad_nu_tau_mu_nu;
    }

    double PBH_baryogenesis(double phi, double M, double K, double eta, double partial_mu_phi, double J_mu_B) {
        return (phi / M) * K + eta * partial_mu_phi * J_mu_B;
    }

    double delta_sigma_dark(double nu, double G, double partial_mu_phi, double partial_mu_phi_conj) {
        return (nu / G) * partial_mu_phi * partial_mu_phi_conj;
    }

    double dot_r_IMRI(double G, double M, double m, double mu, double c, double r, double v) {
        return - (64 * std::pow(G, 3) * std::pow(M, 2) * m * mu) / (5 * std::pow(c, 5) * std::pow(r, 3)) * (1 + (3 * G * M * v) / (2 * std::pow(c, 2) * r));
    }

    double S_f_spectral(double f, double alpha) {
        return std::pow(f, -alpha);
    }

    double g_M16(double G, double M_t, double r, double H_z, double t, double B, double B_crit, double M_sf_t, double Ug_sum, double Lambda, double c, double h_bar, double sqrt_delta_x_p, double integral_psi, double two_pi_t_Hubble, double q, double v_B, double rho_fluid, double V, double g, double A, double k, double x, double omega, double two_pi_13_8, std::complex<double> i_k_x_omega_t, double M_visible, double M_DM, double delta_rho_rho, double three_G_M_r3, double E_rad) {
        double g_base = G * M_t / (r * r);
        double term1 = 1 + H_z * t;
        double term2 = 1 - B / B_crit;
        double term3 = 1 + M_sf_t;
        double term4 = Lambda * c * c / 3;
        double term5 = h_bar / sqrt_delta_x_p * integral_psi * two_pi_t_Hubble;
        double term6 = q * v_B;
        double term7 = rho_fluid * V * g;
        double term8 = 2 * A * std::cos(k * x) * std::cos(omega * t);
        double term9 = two_pi_13_8 * A * std::exp(i_k_x_omega_t);
        double term10 = (M_visible + M_DM) * (delta_rho_rho + three_G_M_r3);
        return g_base * term1 * term2 * term3 + Ug_sum + term4 + term5 + term6 + term7 + term8 + term9 + term10 - E_rad;
    }

    double g_NGC1275(double G, double M, double r, double H_z, double t, double B, double B_crit, double F_BH, double Ug_sum, double Lambda, double c, double h_bar, double sqrt_delta_x_p, double integral_psi, double two_pi_t_Hubble, double q, double v_B, double rho_fluid, double V, double g, double A, double k, double x, double omega, double two_pi_13_8, std::complex<double> i_k_x_omega_t, double M_visible, double M_DM, double delta_rho_rho, double three_G_M_r3, double M_fil) {
        double g_base = G * M / (r * r);
        double term1 = 1 + H_z * t;
        double term2 = 1 - B / B_crit;
        double term3 = Lambda * c * c / 3;
        double term4 = h_bar / sqrt_delta_x_p * integral_psi * two_pi_t_Hubble;

        double term9 = (M_visible + M_DM) * (delta_rho_rho + three_G_M_r3);
        return g_base * term1 * term2 + F_BH + Ug_sum + term3 + term4 + term5 + term6 + term7 + term8 + term9 + M_fil;
    }

    double delta_def(double t) {

    }

    }

    // Uniqueness Probability
    double uniqueness_prob() {
        std::vector<double> sim_scores = {0.05, 0.1, 0.15, 0.2, 0.25};
        double mean = 0.0;
        for (double score : sim_scores) mean += score;
        mean /= sim_scores.size();
        double std_dev = 0.0;
        for (double score : sim_scores) std_dev += (score - mean) * (score - mean);
        std_dev = std::sqrt(std_dev / sim_scores.size());
        double z = (mean - 0.1) / (0.05 * std::sqrt(2.0));
        double cdf = 0.5 * (1.0 + std::erf(z));
        return 1.0 - cdf;  // ~0.1587 general
    }

    // Equation Functions (all from thread, including new MUGE for NGC 2525)
    double F_U(double g_compressed, double sum_Ugi, double sum_mu_j, double g_mu_nu, double F_neutron, double Ui, double F_p, double a_THz, double f_TRZ_log, double PDE, double f_res_term, double sigma_term, double h_TT_ij, double Gamma_term, double Delta_q_term, double W_tau_m_term, double F_nonlocal, double MUGE_term) {

    double E_react(double rho_SCm, double v_SCm, double rho_A, double kappa_decay, double t) {
        return (rho_SCm * v_SCm * v_SCm / rho_A) * std::exp(-kappa_decay * t);

    }

    double f_res(double h_bar, double Z, double m_H, double r_n, double n, double alpha_FS) {
        return (2 * M_PI * h_bar * Z / (m_H * r_n)) * std::sqrt(n / alpha_FS);
    }

    double g_compressed(const SystemParams& params) {
        double g_base = G * params.M / (params.r * params.r);
        double H_z = H0 * std::sqrt(0.3 * std::pow(1 + params.z, 3) + 0.7);
        double term1 = 1 + H_z * params.t;
        double term2 = 1 - params.B / B_crit;
        double term3 = Lambda * c * c / 3;
        double term4 = hbar / std::sqrt(delta_x_delta_p) * psi_H_psi * (2 * M_PI / t_Hubble);
        double term5 = params.rho_fluid * params.V * g_base;
        double term6 = (params.M / 2 + params.M / 2) * (delta_rho_rho + 3 * G * params.M / (params.r * params.r * params.r));
        return g_base * term1 * term2 + term6 + term3 + term4 + term5;  // Simplified
    }

    }

        return 1.2e13 * (beta - beta_o) * (beta - beta_o);

        return Q + alpha / std::log(1 + beta * Q / Q0);

    double g_M16(double G, double M_t, double r, double H_z, double t, double B, double B_crit, double M_sf_t, double Ug_sum, double Lambda, double c, double h_bar, double sqrt_delta_x_p, double integral_psi, double two_pi_t_Hubble, double q, double v_B, double rho_fluid, double V, double g, double A, double k, double x, double omega, double two_pi_13_8, std::complex<double> i_k_x_omega_t, double M_visible, double M_DM, double delta_rho_rho, double three_G_M_r3, double E_rad) {

    double g_NGC1275(double G, double M, double r, double H_z, double t, double B, double B_crit, double F_BH, double Ug_sum, double Lambda, double c, double h_bar, double sqrt_delta_x_p, double integral_psi, double two_pi_t_Hubble, double q, double v_B, double rho_fluid, double V, double g, double A, double k, double x, double omega, double two_pi_13_8, std::complex<double> i_k_x_omega_t, double M_visible, double M_DM, double delta_rho_rho, double three_G_M_r3, double M_fil) {

        double term5 = q * v_B;

        return g_base * term1 * term2 + F_BH + Ug_sum + term3 + term4 + term5 + term6 + term7 + term8 + term9 + M_fil;

    // New: delta_def function
    double delta_def(double t) {
        return 0.01 * std::sin(0.001 * t);
    }

    double pondermotive_F_p(double e, double m, double omega, double grad_E2) {
        return - (e * e / (4 * m * omega * omega)) * grad_E2;
    }

        return - beta_i * U_gi * Omega_g * (M_bh / d_g) * (1 + epsilon_sw * rho_vac_sw) * U_UA * std::cos(M_PI * t_n);
    }

    }

    // New: U_m with f_Heaviside
    double U_m(double mu_j, double r_j, double gamma_decay, double t, double t_n, double phi_hat_j, double P_SCm, double E_react, double f_quasi, double f_Heaviside) {
        return (mu_j / r_j) * (1 - std::exp(-gamma_decay * t * std::cos(M_PI * t_n))) * phi_hat_j * P_SCm * E_react * (1 + std::pow(10, 13) * f_Heaviside) * (1 + f_quasi);
    }

    // New: U_g2 with H_SCm
    double U_g2(double k2, double rho_vac_UA, double rho_vac_SCm, double M_s, double r, double S_r_Rb, double delta_sw, double v_sw, double H_SCm, double E_react) {
        return k2 * ((rho_vac_UA + rho_vac_SCm) * M_s / (r * r)) * S_r_Rb * (1 + delta_sw * v_sw) * H_SCm * E_react;
    }

    // New: U_g3 with P_core
    double U_g3(double k3, double B_j, double omega_s, double t, double P_core, double E_react) {
        return k3 * B_j * std::cos(omega_s * t * M_PI) * P_core * E_react;
    }

    }

    }

    // Uniqueness Probability
    double uniqueness_prob() {
        std::vector<double> sim_scores = {0.05, 0.1, 0.15, 0.2, 0.25};
        double mean = 0.0;
        for (double score : sim_scores) mean += score;
        mean /= sim_scores.size();
        double std_dev = 0.0;
        for (double score : sim_scores) std_dev += (score - mean) * (score - mean);
        std_dev = std::sqrt(std_dev / sim_scores.size());
        double z = (mean - 0.1) / (0.05 * std::sqrt(2.0));
        double cdf = 0.5 * (1.0 + std::erf(z));
        return 1.0 - cdf;  // ~0.1587 general
    }

    double g_compressed(const SystemParams& params) {
        double g_base = G * params.M / (params.r * params.r);
        double H_z = H0 * std::sqrt(0.3 * std::pow(1 + params.z, 3) + 0.7);
        double term1 = 1 + H_z * params.t;
        double term2 = 1 - params.B / B_crit;
        double term3 = Lambda * c * c / 3;
        double term4 = hbar / std::sqrt(delta_x_delta_p) * psi_H_psi * (2 * M_PI / t_Hubble);
        double term5 = params.rho_fluid * params.V * g_base;
        double term6 = (params.M / 2 + params.M / 2) * (delta_rho_rho + 3 * G * params.M / (params.r * params.r * params.r));
        return g_base * term1 * term2 + term6 + term3 + term4 + term5;  // Simplified
    }

        return - beta_i * U_gi * Omega_g * (M_bh / d_g) * (1 + epsilon_sw * rho_vac_sw) * U_UA * std::cos(M_PI * t_n);
    }

    double U_g4(double k4, double rho_vac_SCm, double M_bh, double d_g, double alpha, double t, double t_n, double f_feedback) {

    }

    double U_m(double mu_j, double r_j, double gamma_decay, double t, double t_n, double phi_hat_j, double P_SCm, double E_react, double f_quasi, double f_Heaviside) {
        return (mu_j / r_j) * (1 - std::exp(-gamma_decay * t * std::cos(M_PI * t_n))) * phi_hat_j * P_SCm * E_react * (1 + std::pow(10, 13) * f_Heaviside) * (1 + f_quasi);
    }

    double U_g2(double k2, double rho_vac_UA, double rho_vac_SCm, double M_s, double r, double S_r_Rb, double delta_sw, double v_sw, double H_SCm, double E_react) {
        return k2 * ((rho_vac_UA + rho_vac_SCm) * M_s / (r * r)) * S_r_Rb * (1 + delta_sw * v_sw) * H_SCm * E_react;
    }

    double U_g3(double k3, double B_j, double omega_s, double t, double P_core, double E_react) {
        return k3 * B_j * std::cos(omega_s * t * M_PI) * P_core * E_react;
    }

    // Uniqueness Probability
    double uniqueness_prob() {
        std::vector<double> sim_scores = {0.05, 0.1, 0.15, 0.2, 0.25};
        double mean = 0.0;
        for (double score : sim_scores) mean += score;
        mean /= sim_scores.size();
        double std_dev = 0.0;
        for (double score : sim_scores) std_dev += (score - mean) * (score - mean);
        std_dev = std::sqrt(std_dev / sim_scores.size());
        double z = (mean - 0.1) / (0.05 * std::sqrt(2.0));
        double cdf = 0.5 * (1.0 + std::erf(z));
        return 1.0 - cdf;  // ~0.1587 general
    }

    }

        return (2 * M_PI * h_bar * Z / (m_H * r_n)) * std::sqrt(n / alpha_FS);
    }

    double g_compressed(const SystemParams& params) {
        double g_base = G * params.M / (params.r * params.r);
        double H_z = H0 * std::sqrt(0.3 * std::pow(1 + params.z, 3) + 0.7);
        double term1 = 1 + H_z * params.t;
        double term2 = 1 - params.B / B_crit;
        double term3 = Lambda * c * c / 3;
        double term4 = hbar / std::sqrt(delta_x_delta_p) * psi_H_psi * (2 * M_PI / t_Hubble);
        double term5 = params.rho_fluid * params.V * g_base;
        double term6 = (params.M / 2 + params.M / 2) * (delta_rho_rho + 3 * G * params.M / (params.r * params.r * params.r));
        return g_base * term1 * term2 + term6 + term3 + term4 + term5;  // Simplified
    }

    // Uniqueness Probability
    double uniqueness_prob() {
        std::vector<double> sim_scores = {0.05, 0.1, 0.15, 0.2, 0.25};
        double mean = 0.0;
        for (double score : sim_scores) mean += score;
        mean /= sim_scores.size();
        double std_dev = 0.0;
        for (double score : sim_scores) std_dev += (score - mean) * (score - mean);
        std_dev = std::sqrt(std_dev / sim_scores.size());
        double z = (mean - 0.1) / (0.05 * std::sqrt(2.0));
        double cdf = 0.5 * (1.0 + std::erf(z));
        return 1.0 - cdf;  // ~0.1587 general
    }

    // Equation Functions (all from thread, including new MUGE for NGC 2525)
    double F_U(double g_compressed, double sum_Ugi, double sum_mu_j, double g_mu_nu, double F_neutron, double Ui, double F_p, double a_THz, double f_TRZ_log, double PDE, double f_res_term, double sigma_term, double h_TT_ij, double Gamma_term, double Delta_q_term, double W_tau_m_term, double F_nonlocal, double MUGE_term) {
        return g_compressed + sum_Ugi + sum_mu_j + g_mu_nu + F_neutron + Ui + F_p + a_THz + f_TRZ_log + PDE + f_res_term + sigma_term + h_TT_ij + Gamma_term + Delta_q_term + W_tau_m_term + F_nonlocal + MUGE_term;
    }

    double E_react(double rho_SCm, double v_SCm, double rho_A, double kappa_decay, double t) {
        return (rho_SCm * v_SCm * v_SCm / rho_A) * std::exp(-kappa_decay * t);
    }

    double Ui(double lambda_i, double rho_vac_SCm, double rho_vac_UA, double omega_s, double t_n, double f_TRZ) {
        return lambda_i * rho_vac_SCm * rho_vac_UA * omega_s * std::cos(M_PI * t_n) * (1 + f_TRZ);
    }

    double f_res(double h_bar, double Z, double m_H, double r_n, double n, double alpha_FS) {
        return (2 * M_PI * h_bar * Z / (m_H * r_n)) * std::sqrt(n / alpha_FS);
    }

    double g_compressed(const SystemParams& params) {
        double g_base = G * params.M / (params.r * params.r);
        double H_z = H0 * std::sqrt(0.3 * std::pow(1 + params.z, 3) + 0.7);
        double term1 = 1 + H_z * params.t;
        double term2 = 1 - params.B / B_crit;
        double term3 = Lambda * c * c / 3;
        double term4 = hbar / std::sqrt(delta_x_delta_p) * psi_H_psi * (2 * M_PI / t_Hubble);
        double term5 = params.rho_fluid * params.V * g_base;
        double term6 = (params.M / 2 + params.M / 2) * (delta_rho_rho + 3 * G * params.M / (params.r * params.r * params.r));
        return g_base * term1 * term2 + term6 + term3 + term4 + term5;  // Simplified
    }

    double F_nonlocal(double v_p, double v_g, double t, double F_rel) {
        return (v_p / v_g) * std::exp(-(M_PI - t)) * F_rel;
    }

    double Delta_q(double p_Q) {
        return p_Q * p_Q + p_Q;
    }

    double Gamma_LENR(double beta, double beta_o) {
        return 1.2e13 * (beta - beta_o) * (beta - beta_o);
    }

    double h_TT_ij(double r, double d2_I_kl, double P_ik, double P_jl) {
        return (2 / r) * d2_I_kl * P_ik * P_jl;
    }

    double Q_lambda_f(double c_lambda, double integral_e_H_Ff) {
        return 1.0 / (c_lambda * c_lambda) * integral_e_H_Ff;
    }

    double f_Q_log(double Q, double alpha, double beta, double Q0) {
        return Q + alpha * std::log(1 + beta * Q / Q0);
    }

    double f_Q_inverse_log(double Q, double alpha, double beta, double Q0) {
        return Q + alpha / std::log(1 + beta * Q / Q0);
    }

    double neutrino_transport(double df_nu_dt, double v_grad_f_nu, double C_f_nu) {
        return df_nu_dt + v_grad_f_nu - C_f_nu;
    }

    double log_M_BH(double sigma) {
        return 0.309 * std::log(sigma / 200) + 4.38;
    }

    bool He_core_threshold(double M_He) {
        return M_He > 5.6;
    }

    double viscous_hydro(double partial_t_u_mu, double u_nu_grad_nu_u_mu, double epsilon_P, double grad_mu_P, double u_mu_u_nu_grad_nu_P, double nu_grad_nu_tau_mu_nu) {
        return partial_t_u_mu + u_nu_grad_nu_u_mu + 1.0 / epsilon_P * (grad_mu_P + u_mu_u_nu_grad_nu_P) + nu_grad_nu_tau_mu_nu;
    }

    double PBH_baryogenesis(double phi, double M, double K, double eta, double partial_mu_phi, double J_mu_B) {
        return (phi / M) * K + eta * partial_mu_phi * J_mu_B;
    }

    double delta_sigma_dark(double nu, double G, double partial_mu_phi, double partial_mu_phi_conj) {
        return (nu / G) * partial_mu_phi * partial_mu_phi_conj;
    }

    double dot_r_IMRI(double G, double M, double m, double mu, double c, double r, double v) {
        return - (64 * std::pow(G, 3) * std::pow(M, 2) * m * mu) / (5 * std::pow(c, 5) * std::pow(r, 3)) * (1 + (3 * G * M * v) / (2 * std::pow(c, 2) * r));
    }

    double S_f_spectral(double f, double alpha) {
        return std::pow(f, -alpha);
    }

    double g_M16(double G, double M_t, double r, double H_z, double t, double B, double B_crit, double M_sf_t, double Ug_sum, double Lambda, double c, double h_bar, double sqrt_delta_x_p, double integral_psi, double two_pi_t_Hubble, double q, double v_B, double rho_fluid, double V, double g, double A, double k, double x, double omega, double two_pi_13_8, std::complex<double> i_k_x_omega_t, double M_visible, double M_DM, double delta_rho_rho, double three_G_M_r3, double E_rad) {
        double g_base = G * M_t / (r * r);
        double term1 = 1 + H_z * t;
        double term2 = 1 - B / B_crit;
        double term3 = 1 + M_sf_t;
        double term4 = Lambda * c * c / 3;
        double term5 = h_bar / sqrt_delta_x_p * integral_psi * two_pi_t_Hubble;
        double term6 = q * v_B;
        double term7 = rho_fluid * V * g;
        double term8 = 2 * A * std::cos(k * x) * std::cos(omega * t);
        double term9 = two_pi_13_8 * A * std::exp(i_k_x_omega_t);
        double term10 = (M_visible + M_DM) * (delta_rho_rho + three_G_M_r3);
        return g_base * term1 * term2 * term3 + Ug_sum + term4 + term5 + term6 + term7 + term8 + term9 + term10 - E_rad;
    }

    double g_NGC1275(double G, double M, double r, double H_z, double t, double B, double B_crit, double F_BH, double Ug_sum, double Lambda, double c, double h_bar, double sqrt_delta_x_p, double integral_psi, double two_pi_t_Hubble, double q, double v_B, double rho_fluid, double V, double g, double A, double k, double x, double omega, double two_pi_13_8, std::complex<double> i_k_x_omega_t, double M_visible, double M_DM, double delta_rho_rho, double three_G_M_r3, double M_fil) {
        double g_base = G * M / (r * r);
        double term1 = 1 + H_z * t;
        double term2 = 1 - B / B_crit;
        double term3 = Lambda * c * c / 3;
        double term4 = h_bar / sqrt(delta_x_delta_p) * integral_psi * two_pi_t_Hubble;
        double term5 = q * v_B;
        double term6 = rho_fluid * V * g;
        double term7 = 2 * A * std::cos(k * x) * std::cos(omega * t);
        double term8 = two_pi_13_8 * A * std::exp(i_k_x_omega_t);
        double term9 = (M_visible + M_DM) * (delta_rho_rho + three_G_M_r3);
        return g_base * term1 * term2 + F_BH + Ug_sum + term3 + term4 + term5 + term6 + term7 + term8 + term9 + M_fil;
    }

    // New: delta_def function
    double delta_def(double t) {
        return 0.01 * std::sin(0.001 * t);
    }

    // New: U_g1 with delta_def
    double U_g1(double k1, double mu_s, double grad_M_s_r, double alpha, double t, double t_n, double delta_def_val) {
        return k1 * mu_s * grad_M_s_r * std::exp(-alpha * t) * std::cos(M_PI * t_n) * (1 + delta_def_val);
    }

    // New: Pondermotive force F_p (from Ideal Gravity integration)
    double pondermotive_F_p(double e, double m, double omega, double grad_E2) {
        return - (e * e / (4 * m * omega * omega)) * grad_E2;
    }

    // New: A_mu_nu (simplified scalar for example)
    double A_mu_nu(double g_mu_nu, double eta, double T_s_mu_nu) {
        return g_mu_nu + eta * T_s_mu_nu;
    }

    // New: U_bi with epsilon_sw
    double U_bi(double beta_i, double U_gi, double Omega_g, double M_bh, double d_g, double epsilon_sw, double rho_vac_sw, double U_UA, double t_n) {
        return - beta_i * U_gi * Omega_g * (M_bh / d_g) * (1 + epsilon_sw * rho_vac_sw) * U_UA * std::cos(M_PI * t_n);
    }

    // New: U_g4 with f_feedback
    double U_g4(double k4, double rho_vac_SCm, double M_bh, double d_g, double alpha, double t, double t_n, double f_feedback) {
        return k4 * (rho_vac_SCm * M_bh / d_g) * std::exp(-alpha * t) * std::cos(M_PI * t_n) * (1 + f_feedback);
    }

    // New: U_m with f_Heaviside
    double U_m(double mu_j, double r_j, double gamma_decay, double t, double t_n, double phi_hat_j, double P_SCm, double E_react, double f_quasi, double f_Heaviside) {
        return (mu_j / r_j) * (1 - std::exp(-gamma_decay * t * std::cos(M_PI * t_n))) * phi_hat_j * P_SCm * E_react * (1 + std::pow(10, 13) * f_Heaviside) * (1 + f_quasi);
    }

    // New: U_g2 with H_SCm
    double U_g2(double k2, double rho_vac_UA, double rho_vac_SCm, double M_s, double r, double S_r_Rb, double delta_sw, double v_sw, double H_SCm, double E_react) {
        return k2 * ((rho_vac_UA + rho_vac_SCm) * M_s / (r * r)) * S_r_Rb * (1 + delta_sw * v_sw) * H_SCm * E_react;
    }

    // New: U_g3 with P_core
    double U_g3(double k3, double B_j, double omega_s, double t, double P_core, double E_react) {
        return k3 * B_j * std::cos(omega_s * t * M_PI) * P_core * E_react;
    }

        return g_compressed + sum_Ugi + sum_mu_j + g_mu_nu + F_neutron + Ui + F_p + a_THz + f_TRZ_log + PDE + f_res_term + sigma_term + h_TT_ij + Gamma_term + Delta_q_term + W_tau_m_term + F_nonlocal + MUGE_term;
    }

    double E_react(double rho_SCm, double v_SCm, double rho_A, double kappa_decay, double t) {
        return (rho_SCm * v_SCm * v_SCm / rho_A) * std::exp(-kappa_decay * t);
    }

    double Ui(double lambda_i, double rho_vac_SCm, double rho_vac_UA, double omega_s, double t_n, double f_TRZ) {
        return lambda_i * rho_vac_SCm * rho_vac_UA * omega_s * std::cos(M_PI * t_n) * (1 + f_TRZ);
    }

    double f_res(double h_bar, double Z, double m_H, double r_n, double n, double alpha_FS) {
        return (2 * M_PI * h_bar * Z / (m_H * r_n)) * std::sqrt(n / alpha_FS);
    }

    double g_compressed(const SystemParams& params) {
        double g_base = G * params.M / (params.r * params.r);
        double H_z = H0 * std::sqrt(0.3 * std::pow(1 + params.z, 3) + 0.7);
        double term1 = 1 + H_z * params.t;
        double term2 = 1 - params.B / B_crit;
        double term3 = Lambda * c * c / 3;
        double term4 = hbar / std::sqrt(delta_x_delta_p) * psi_H_psi * (2 * M_PI / t_Hubble);
        double term5 = params.rho_fluid * params.V * g_base;
        double term6 = (params.M / 2 + params.M / 2) * (delta_rho_rho + 3 * G * params.M / (params.r * params.r * params.r));
        return g_base * term1 * term2 + term6 + term3 + term4 + term5;  // Simplified
    }

    double F_nonlocal(double v_p, double v_g, double t, double F_rel) {
        return (v_p / v_g) * std::exp(-(M_PI - t)) * F_rel;
    }

    double Delta_q(double p_Q) {
        return p_Q * p_Q + p_Q;
    }

    double Gamma_LENR(double beta, double beta_o) {
        return 1.2e13 * (beta - beta_o) * (beta - beta_o);
    }

    double h_TT_ij(double r, double d2_I_kl, double P_ik, double P_jl) {
        return (2 / r) * d2_I_kl * P_ik * P_jl;
    }

    double Q_lambda_f(double c_lambda, double integral_e_H_Ff) {
        return 1.0 / (c_lambda * c_lambda) * integral_e_H_Ff;
    }

    double f_Q_log(double Q, double alpha, double beta, double Q0) {
        return Q + alpha * std::log(1 + beta * Q / Q0);
    }

    double f_Q_inverse_log(double Q, double alpha, double beta, double Q0) {
        return Q + alpha / std::log(1 + beta * Q / Q0);
    }

    double neutrino_transport(double df_nu_dt, double v_grad_f_nu, double C_f_nu) {
        return df_nu_dt + v_grad_f_nu - C_f_nu;
    }

    double log_M_BH(double sigma) {
        return 0.309 * std::log(sigma / 200) + 4.38;
    }

    }

    double viscous_hydro(double partial_t_u_mu, double u_nu_grad_nu_u_mu, double epsilon_P, double grad_mu_P, double u_mu_u_nu_grad_nu_P, double nu_grad_nu_tau_mu_nu) {
        return partial_t_u_mu + u_nu_grad_nu_u_mu + 1.0 / epsilon_P * (grad_mu_P + u_mu_u_nu_grad_nu_P) + nu_grad_nu_tau_mu_nu;
    }

    double PBH_baryogenesis(double phi, double M, double K, double eta, double partial_mu_phi, double J_mu_B) {
        return (phi / M) * K + eta * partial_mu_phi * J_mu_B;

        return (nu / G) * partial_mu_phi * partial_mu_phi_conj;
    }

    double dot_r_IMRI(double G, double M, double m, double mu, double c, double r, double v) {
        return - (64 * std::pow(G, 3) * std::pow(M, 2) * m * mu) / (5 * std::pow(c, 5) * std::pow(r, 3)) * (1 + (3 * G * M * v) / (2 * std::pow(c, 2) * r));
    }

    double S_f_spectral(double f, double alpha) {
        return std::pow(f, -alpha);
    }

    double g_M16(double G, double M_t, double r, double H_z, double t, double B, double B_crit, double M_sf_t, double Ug_sum, double Lambda, double c, double h_bar, double sqrt_delta_x_p, double integral_psi, double two_pi_t_Hubble, double q, double v_B, double rho_fluid, double V, double g, double A, double k, double x, double omega, double two_pi_13_8, std::complex<double> i_k_x_omega_t, double M_visible, double M_DM, double delta_rho_rho, double three_G_M_r3, double E_rad) {
        double g_base = G * M_t / (r * r);
        double term1 = 1 + H_z * t;
        double term2 = 1 - B / B_crit;
        double term3 = 1 + M_sf_t;

        double term5 = h_bar / sqrt_delta_x_p * integral_psi * two_pi_t_Hubble;
        double term6 = q * v_B;
        double term7 = rho_fluid * V * g;

        double term9 = two_pi_13_8 * A * std::exp(i_k_x_omega_t);
        double term10 = (M_visible + M_DM) * (delta_rho_rho + three_G_M_r3);

    }

    double g_NGC1275(double G, double M, double r, double H_z, double t, double B, double B_crit, double F_BH, double Ug_sum, double Lambda, double c, double h_bar, double sqrt_delta_x_p, double integral_psi, double two_pi_t_Hubble, double q, double v_B, double rho_fluid, double V, double g, double A, double k, double x, double omega, double two_pi_13_8, std::complex<double> i_k_x_omega_t, double M_visible, double M_DM, double delta_rho_rho, double three_G_M_r3, double M_fil) {

With λ_q=1.0 (assumed), ρ_{vac,[SCm]}=7.09e-37 J/m^3, ρ_{vac,[UA]}=7.09e-36 J/m^3, ω_q=1e20 rad/s (approximated), t_n=0, f_TRZ=0.1, [SS_q]^n 26 e^{( -π - t )}=1.New Example Solution for U_u (up quark)For up quark at t = 0, n = 1:
•	Parameters:
•	m_u = 3.95e-30 kg
•	q_u = 1.07e-19 C
•	ω_u = 1e20 rad/s
•	Solution for E_u:
Eu=3.95×10−30⋅(3×108)2⋅e1/26≈3.56×10−13⋅1.038≈3.70×10−13 J
•	Solution for U_u:
Uu=1.0⋅(7.09×10−37)⋅(7.09×10−36)⋅(1020)⋅1⋅1.1⋅1≈5.53×10−33 J/m3

// UQFF Framework C++ Implementation (Updated with η, δ_def, f_TRZ, pondermotive, ε_sw, k_i, d_g, f_feedback, f_Heaviside, H_SCm, λ_i, μ_j, M_bh, t_n, f_quasi, R_b, γ, P_SCm, κ, δ_sw, v_sw, B_s, S, MUGE_Equations_Atom)
#define M_PI 3.14159265358979323846

namespace UQFF {
    // Constants (updated with NGC 1275)

    const double c = 3e8;
    const double hbar = 1.054e-34;
    const double Lambda = 1.19e-52;
    const double H0 = 2.27e-18;
    const double rho_vac_UA = 7.09e-36;
    const double k_LENR = 1e-10;
    const double omega_LENR = 2 * M_PI * 1.25e12;
    const double omega_0 = 1e-15;
    const double k_neutron = 1e10;
    const double sigma_n = 1e-32;
    const double F_rel = 4.3e33;
    const double F_0 = 1.83e71;
    const double m_e = 9.11e-31;
    const double DPM = 0.01;
    const double f_DPM = 1e12;
    const double F_DPM = 5.626e50;
    const double E_vac_neb = 7.09e-36;
    const double delta_x_delta_p = hbar / 2;
    const double psi_H_psi = 1;
    const double t_Hubble = 4.35e17;
    const double delta_rho_rho = 1e-5;
    const double B_crit = 1e9;
    const double kappa = 5.787e-9;
    const double gamma = 5.787e-10;
    const double f_TRZ = 0.1;  // Time-Reversal Zone factor
    const double a = 1e-10;
    const double b = 0.00472;
    const double c_val = -1.83e71;

    const double eta = 1e-22;  // Aether coupling constant
    const double epsilon_sw = 0.001;  // Buoyancy modulation by solar wind density
    const double rho_vac_sw = 8e-21;  // Solar wind vacuum energy density
    const double k1 = 1.5;  // Coupling constants for Ug ranges
    const double k2 = 1.2;
    const double k3 = 1.8;
    const double k4 = 1.0;
    const double d_g = 2.55e20;  // Distance from galactic center

    const double Omega_g = 7.3e-16;  // Galactic spin rate rad/s
    const double f_Heaviside = 0.01;  // Heaviside component fraction
    const double H_SCm = 1.0;  // Heliosphere thickness factor ~1
    const double lambda_i = 1.0;  // Inertia coupling constants (uniform)
    const double omega_c = 2 * M_PI / 3.96e8;  // Solar cycle frequency s^{-1}
    const double M_bh = 8.15e36;  // Mass of the galactic black hole kg
    const double P_core = 1.0;  // Planetary core penetration factor ~1 for Sun
    const double f_quasi = 0.01;  // Quasi-longitudinal wave factor
    const double R_b = 1.496e13;  // Radius of the outer field bubble m
    const double gamma_decay = 0.00005;  // Reciprocation decay rate day^{-1}
    const double P_SCm = 1.0;  // [SCm] penetration factor ~1 for Sun
    const double kappa_decay = 0.0005;  // [SCm] reactivity decay rate day^{-1}
    const double delta_sw = 0.01;  // Solar wind modulation factor

    const double B_s_max = 0.4;  // Surface magnetic field max T for Sun

    // Uniqueness Probability
    double uniqueness_prob() {
        std::vector<double> sim_scores = {0.05, 0.1, 0.15, 0.2, 0.25};
        double mean = 0.0;
        for (double score : sim_scores) mean += score;
        mean /= sim_scores.size();
        double std_dev = 0.0;
        for (double score : sim_scores) std_dev += (score - mean) * (score - mean);
        std_dev = std::sqrt(std_dev / sim_scores.size());
        double z = (mean - 0.1) / (0.05 * std::sqrt(2.0));
        double cdf = 0.5 * (1.0 + std::erf(z));
        return 1.0 - cdf;  // ~0.1587 general
    }

    // Equation Functions (all from thread, including new MUGE for NGC 2525)
    double F_U(double g_compressed, double sum_Ugi, double sum_mu_j, double g_mu_nu, double F_neutron, double Ui, double F_p, double a_THz, double f_TRZ_log, double PDE, double f_res_term, double sigma_term, double h_TT_ij, double Gamma_term, double Delta_q_term, double W_tau_m_term, double F_nonlocal, double MUGE_term) {
        return g_compressed + sum_Ugi + sum_mu_j + g_mu_nu + F_neutron + Ui + F_p + a_THz + f_TRZ_log + PDE + f_res_term + sigma_term + h_TT_ij + Gamma_term + Delta_q_term + W_tau_m_term + F_nonlocal + MUGE_term;
    }

    double E_react(double rho_SCm, double v_SCm, double rho_A, double kappa_decay, double t) {
        return (rho_SCm * v_SCm * v_SCm / rho_A) * std::exp(-kappa_decay * t);
    }

    double Ui(double lambda_i, double rho_vac_SCm, double rho_vac_UA, double omega_s, double t_n, double f_TRZ) {
        return lambda_i * rho_vac_SCm * rho_vac_UA * omega_s * std::cos(M_PI * t_n) * (1 + f_TRZ);
    }

    double f_res(double h_bar, double Z, double m_H, double r_n, double n, double alpha_FS) {
        return (2 * M_PI * h_bar * Z / (m_H * r_n)) * std::sqrt(n / alpha_FS);
    }

    double g_compressed(const SystemParams& params) {
        double g_base = G * params.M / (params.r * params.r);
        double H_z = H0 * std::sqrt(0.3 * std::pow(1 + params.z, 3) + 0.7);
        double term1 = 1 + H_z * params.t;
        double term2 = 1 - params.B / B_crit;
        double term3 = Lambda * c * c / 3;
        double term4 = hbar / std::sqrt(delta_x_delta_p) * psi_H_psi * (2 * M_PI / t_Hubble);
        double term5 = params.rho_fluid * params.V * g_base;
        double term6 = (params.M / 2 + params.M / 2) * (delta_rho_rho + 3 * G * params.M / (params.r * params.r * params.r));
        return g_base * term1 * term2 + term6 + term3 + term4 + term5;  // Simplified
    }

    double F_nonlocal(double v_p, double v_g, double t, double F_rel) {
        return (v_p / v_g) * std::exp(-(M_PI - t)) * F_rel;
    }

    double Delta_q(double p_Q) {
        return p_Q * p_Q + p_Q;
    }

    double Gamma_LENR(double beta, double beta_o) {
        return 1.2e13 * (beta - beta_o) * (beta - beta_o);
    }

    double h_TT_ij(double r, double d2_I_kl, double P_ik, double P_jl) {
        return (2 / r) * d2_I_kl * P_ik * P_jl;
    }

    double Q_lambda_f(double c_lambda, double integral_e_H_Ff) {
        return 1.0 / (c_lambda * c_lambda) * integral_e_H_Ff;
    }

    double f_Q_log(double Q, double alpha, double beta, double Q0) {
        return Q + alpha * std::log(1 + beta * Q / Q0);
    }

    double f_Q_inverse_log(double Q, double alpha, double beta, double Q0) {
        return Q + alpha / std::log(1 + beta * Q / Q0);
    }

    double neutrino_transport(double df_nu_dt, double v_grad_f_nu, double C_f_nu) {
        return df_nu_dt + v_grad_f_nu - C_f_nu;
    }

    double log_M_BH(double sigma) {
        return 0.309 * std::log(sigma / 200) + 4.38;
    }

    bool He_core_threshold(double M_He) {
        return M_He > 5.6;
    }

    double viscous_hydro(double partial_t_u_mu, double u_nu_grad_nu_u_mu, double epsilon_P, double grad_mu_P, double u_mu_u_nu_grad_nu_P, double nu_grad_nu_tau_mu_nu) {
        return partial_t_u_mu + u_nu_grad_nu_u_mu + 1.0 / epsilon_P * (grad_mu_P + u_mu_u_nu_grad_nu_P) + nu_grad_nu_tau_mu_nu;
    }

    double PBH_baryogenesis(double phi, double M, double K, double eta, double partial_mu_phi, double J_mu_B) {
        return (phi / M) * K + eta * partial_mu_phi * J_mu_B;
    }

    double delta_sigma_dark(double nu, double G, double partial_mu_phi, double partial_mu_phi_conj) {
        return (nu / G) * partial_mu_phi * partial_mu_phi_conj;
    }

    double dot_r_IMRI(double G, double M, double m, double mu, double c, double r, double v) {
        return - (64 * std::pow(G, 3) * std::pow(M, 2) * m * mu) / (5 * std::pow(c, 5) * std::pow(r, 3)) * (1 + (3 * G * M * v) / (2 * std::pow(c, 2) * r));
    }

    double S_f_spectral(double f, double alpha) {
        return std::pow(f, -alpha);
    }

    double g_M16(double G, double M_t, double r, double H_z, double t, double B, double B_crit, double M_sf_t, double Ug_sum, double Lambda, double c, double h_bar, double sqrt_delta_x_p, double integral_psi, double two_pi_t_Hubble, double q, double v_B, double rho_fluid, double V, double g, double A, double k, double x, double omega, double two_pi_13_8, std::complex<double> i_k_x_omega_t, double M_visible, double M_DM, double delta_rho_rho, double three_G_M_r3, double E_rad) {
        double g_base = G * M_t / (r * r);
        double term1 = 1 + H_z * t;
        double term2 = 1 - B / B_crit;
        double term3 = 1 + M_sf_t;
        double term4 = Lambda * c * c / 3;
        double term5 = h_bar / sqrt_delta_x_p * integral_psi * two_pi_t_Hubble;
        double term6 = q * v_B;
        double term7 = rho_fluid * V * g;
        double term8 = 2 * A * std::cos(k * x) * std::cos(omega * t);
        double term9 = two_pi_13_8 * A * std::exp(i_k_x_omega_t);
        double term10 = (M_visible + M_DM) * (delta_rho_rho + three_G_M_r3);
        return g_base * term1 * term2 * term3 + Ug_sum + term4 + term5 + term6 + term7 + term8 + term9 + term10 - E_rad;
    }

    double g_NGC1275(double G, double M, double r, double H_z, double t, double B, double B_crit, double F_BH, double Ug_sum, double Lambda, double c, double h_bar, double sqrt_delta_x_p, double integral_psi, double two_pi_t_Hubble, double q, double v_B, double rho_fluid, double V, double g, double A, double k, double x, double omega, double two_pi_13_8, std::complex<double> i_k_x_omega_t, double M_visible, double M_DM, double delta_rho_rho, double three_G_M_r3, double M_fil) {
        double g_base = G * M / (r * r);
        double term1 = 1 + H_z * t;
        double term2 = 1 - B / B_crit;
        double term3 = Lambda * c * c / 3;
        double term4 = h_bar / sqrt(delta_x_delta_p) * integral_psi * two_pi_t_Hubble;
        double term5 = q * v_B;
        double term6 = rho_fluid * V * g;
        double term7 = 2 * A * std::cos(k * x) * std::cos(omega * t);
        double term8 = two_pi_13_8 * A * std::exp(i_k_x_omega_t);
        double term9 = (M_visible + M_DM) * (delta_rho_rho + three_G_M_r3);
        return g_base * term1 * term2 + F_BH + Ug_sum + term3 + term4 + term5 + term6 + term7 + term8 + term9 + M_fil;
    }

    // New: delta_def function
    double delta_def(double t) {
        return 0.01 * std::sin(0.001 * t);
    }

    // New: U_g1 with delta_def
    double U_g1(double k1, double mu_s, double grad_M_s_r, double alpha, double t, double t_n, double delta_def_val) {
        return k1 * mu_s * grad_M_s_r * std::exp(-alpha * t) * std::cos(M_PI * t_n) * (1 + delta_def_val);
    }

    // New: Pondermotive force F_p (from Ideal Gravity integration)
    double pondermotive_F_p(double e, double m, double omega, double grad_E2) {
        return - (e * e / (4 * m * omega * omega)) * grad_E2;
    }

    // New: A_mu_nu (simplified scalar for example)
    double A_mu_nu(double g_mu_nu, double eta, double T_s_mu_nu) {
        return g_mu_nu + eta * T_s_mu_nu;
    }

    // New: U_bi with epsilon_sw
    double U_bi(double beta_i, double U_gi, double Omega_g, double M_bh, double d_g, double epsilon_sw, double rho_vac_sw, double U_UA, double t_n) {
        return - beta_i * U_gi * Omega_g * (M_bh / d_g) * (1 + epsilon_sw * rho_vac_sw) * U_UA * std::cos(M_PI * t_n);
    }

    // New: U_g4 with f_feedback
    double U_g4(double k4, double rho_vac_SCm, double M_bh, double d_g, double alpha, double t, double t_n, double f_feedback) {
        return k4 * (rho_vac_SCm * M_bh / d_g) * std::exp(-alpha * t) * std::cos(M_PI * t_n) * (1 + f_feedback);
    }

    // New: U_m with f_Heaviside
    double U_m(double mu_j, double r_j, double gamma_decay, double t, double t_n, double phi_hat_j, double P_SCm, double E_react, double f_quasi, double f_Heaviside) {
        return (mu_j / r_j) * (1 - std::exp(-gamma_decay * t * std::cos(M_PI * t_n))) * phi_hat_j * P_SCm * E_react * (1 + std::pow(10, 13) * f_Heaviside) * (1 + f_quasi);
    }

    // New: U_g2 with H_SCm
    double U_g2(double k2, double rho_vac_UA, double rho_vac_SCm, double M_s, double r, double S_r_Rb, double delta_sw, double v_sw, double H_SCm, double E_react) {
        return k2 * ((rho_vac_UA + rho_vac_SCm) * M_s / (r * r)) * S_r_Rb * (1 + delta_sw * v_sw) * H_SCm * E_react;
    }

    // New: U_g3 with P_core
    double U_g3(double k3, double B_j, double omega_s, double t, double P_core, double E_react) {
        return k3 * B_j * std::cos(omega_s * t * M_PI) * P_core * E_react;
    }

    // New: mu_j function
    double mu_j_func(double omega_c, double t) {
        return (1000 + 0.4 * std::sin(omega_c * t)) * 3.38e20;
    }

    // New: B_j function (simplified)
    double B_j_func(double omega_c, double t) {
        return 1000 + 0.4 * std::sin(omega_c * t);
    }

        double t = 0.0;
        double example_B_j = B_j_func(omega_c, t);
        std::cout << "B_j (at t=0): " << example_B_j << std::endl;

        return 0;
    }

Evaluate: The Higgs boson discovery and measurements La découverte du boson de Higgs et les mesures Author links Rosy Nicolaidou a 1, Yves Sirois b 2 https://doi.org/10.1016/j.crhy.2015.03.015 Get rights and content Under an Elsevier user license Abstract The discovery of the Higgs boson at a mass around 125 GeV by the ATLAS and CMS experiments at the LHC collider in 2012 establishes a new landscape in high-energy physics. The analysis of the full data sample collected with pp collisions at centre-of-mass energies of 7 and 8 TeV has allowed for considerable progress since the discovery.
